title: 3. Witty
slide_intent: Define the limits of wit so writers can express personality without creating the wrong impression.
strategic_value: Quick cultural references can make Burger King feel alert and personable while protecting warmth.
demonstration: Sarcastic, ironic and smart language is bounded by cautions against cruelty, cynicism and highbrow expression. The right column compares short jokes and cultural references with insults, officious wording and elaborate mythology.
practical_value: Test a joke for respect and accessibility before using it as brand voice.
